## CSS functions and other units

![A figure with a clamp() width and an uppercase unit gap.](plot.png){#fig-clamp .wrap-left width="clamp(150px, 30%, 400px)" wrap-gap="2VMIN"}

In HTML the figure takes both values with no warning. LaTeX, Typst, and Word cannot use them, so they take the defaults and the render prints a warning for each. See @fig-clamp. Lorem ipsum, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.

## A long caption near the bottom of a page

```{=latex}
% Moves the figure below near the bottom of the page.
\vspace{0.6\textheight}
```

```{=openxml}
<!-- Moves the figure below near the bottom of the page in Word: 0.6 of the 12960 twips of text height on a Letter page with 1 in margins. -->
<w:p><w:pPr><w:spacing w:before="7776" w:after="0"/></w:pPr></w:p>
```

![A figure near the bottom of a page, with a caption that runs to three or more lines in its narrow box.](plot.png){#fig-bottom .wrap-right width="150px"}
